name: sts:AssumeRole over a partial-wildcard role path (broad/scoped threshold)
note: The role ARN wildcards the role-name portion (role/app-*), so it reaches MANY roles, not one - this is the true boundary of resourceListIsBroadForAssume (a partial wildcard is broad, a single concrete role ARN is not). Must be flagged as ASSUME-ROLE-EXPANSION. Pins the broad-vs-scoped discriminator so treating role/app-* as scoped would regress.
